messages:
Maya: Quick idea 10am hill-repeats + micro boulder session after work? 6x30s uphill sprints then 30min easy projects. meet at front steps.
Connor: I'm in for the sprints. will bring a stopwatch and a little chalk ball.
Diego: can we keep the boulder part very beginner friendly? I'm still rehabbing an ankle.
Maya: absolutely. low-footwork routes, no dynos. ankle-friendly options.
Lina: love this. can someone share a warmdown stretch sequence? I always forget.
Priya: 3x30s calf stretch, hamstring band, quad stretch + 2min easy walk. done.
Owen: remote today but can I submit a route suggestion? low slab with lots of smears.
Maya: yes please drop the photo here or DM, we'll tape it on the board.
fitbot: Heads up: remember to log equipment use in the "Garage Gear" doc and reapply tape to crash pads after use.
Connor: also FYI the cafe is doing a limited cold-press run. anyone want nitro coffee after?
Diego: nitro for me. or banana smoothie if you want to refund my energy.
Lina: tiny poll: nitro vs banana vs matcha? react with :coffee: :banana: :tea: to vote.
Priya: :banana: (but if there's protein powder Ill take that too).
Owen: sending some rehab-friendly calf mobility drills in a thread after this.
Maya: sweet. running list: sprints, easy boulder, warmdown, nitro/banana poll. see y'all 5:45pm. pics encouraged but no identifying photos of other folks without consent.
Connor: bringing spare ankle tape and a tiny first-aid kit.
Diego: appreciate that. also any tips for not overstretching after sprints?
Priya: slow heart-rate drop: 5 minutes easy walk, then the stretching sequence.
Lina: excited! will try to film a slow-motion slab beta for Owen's route.
Maya: perfect. adding event to calendar now: https://calendar.redwood.company/events/1789999012-hill-sprint-boulder (RSVP there).
fitbot: Note: this is an employee-organized wellness activity. Check your calendar conflicts before RSVP.
Maya: last thing 1 please label your shoes if you grab spares from the locker. we had a mixup last month.
Connor: noted. see you all later. :running_shirt_with_sash:
